input.quote: The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month.
input.rationale: Fees are purely a revenue share on actual Net Sales above a monthly threshold; there is no minimum purchase, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume-cap obligation on us. (The separate termination payment in Section 4.2 is addressed under the liquidated-damages rule.) No redline needed here.

input.quote: The Termination Payment, if any, shall be payable by the Company in eight (8) equal payments to be made quarterly, commencing thirty (30) days after the termination date.
input.rationale: Section 4 deals only with term and the termination payment; nothing requires HDI to hand back our Content, customer and order data or to help migrate the Site, and the Section 10.7 survival list does not cover data return. We inserted a Section 4.3 requiring up to six months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of our data in machine-readable form within 30 days, certified deletion thereafter, and no withholding of data as leverage.
